blocks.text: Material bodies (maadi cheezein) ki sab motions (chalne ki qismon) mein circular motion (daire mein chalna) nature mein sab se zyada nazar aati hai. Zameen ke gird circular orbits mein ghoomte satellites, khud Zameen ki orbital motion aur spin motion (apne axis par ghoomna), mor par murti car, aur dori se ghumaya gaya patthar iski aam misalein hain. Jab cheezein daire mein chalti hain to un ki direction (rukh) lagatar badalti rehti hai. Velocity vector quantity hai, is liye direction badalne ka matlab hai ke velocity constant nahi rehti.
Is chapter mein hum circular motion, rotational motion (apne axis par ghoomna), moment of inertia, angular momentum aur in se related topics parhenge.

Daire ke centre (beech ka point) O par arc (daire ka tukra) AB se banne wala angle lein (Fig. 3.1). Agar arc AB ki lambai daire ke radius r ke barabar ho to centre par banne wala angle ek radian kehlata hai. Radian angle napne ka SI unit hai aur is ka symbol “rad” hai.

blocks.alt: Centre O wala daira. Do radius OA aur OB, dono par r likha hai, ek rangeen sector gherte hain; arc (daire ka tukra) AB ki lambai radius ke barabar hai aur O par angle (kona) 1 rad likha hai. Daire ke bahar mura teer A se B ki taraf jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.1: Ek radian: centre O par woh angle jo radius r ke barabar arc AB banata hai (kitab ki Figure 3.1 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Angular Displacement

Mass m ka ek particle P lein jo radius r ke daire mein chal raha hai. Farz karein P lambai r ki ek massless (jis ka mass na ho) rigid rod ke sire par laga hai, aur chhari ka doosra sira daire ke centre O par pivot hai (Fig. 3.2a). Jab particle daire par chalta hai to chhari OP daire ke plane (chapta hissa) mein ghoomti hai. Rotation (ghoomna) ka axis (axis of rotation) pivot O se guzarta hai aur rotation ke plane par perpendicular (90° par) hai. Axes Fig. 3.2(b) ki tarah lein: z-axis rotation ke axis ke saath, O origin par; x aur y axes rotation ke plane mein. Kisi waqt t par OP ki jagah OP₁ hai jo x-axis se angle θ banati hai. Thore baad waqt t + Δt par yeh OP₂ hai jo x-axis se angle θ + Δθ banati hai (Fig. 3.2c).

blocks.alt: Centre O wala daira. Lambai r ki chhari O ko daire par particle P se jorti hai; P ke qareeb bahar teer dikhata hai ke P ghari ki sui ke ulat (anticlockwise) chal raha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.2(a): Lambai r ki chhari OP ke sire par daire mein chalta particle P (kitab ki Figure 3.2(a) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.alt: Rotation ka daira perspective mein ellipse (ande jaisa lamba gol) dikhaya gaya hai, centre O. O se dashed axes: z seedha oopar rotation ke axis ke saath, y daen taraf aur x dekhne wale ki taraf. Lambai r ki chhari OP daire par particle P tak jati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.2(b): Rotation ke axes: z rotation ke axis ke saath O se, x aur y rotation ke plane mein (kitab ki Figure 3.2(b) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.alt: Centre O wala daira, daen taraf dashed x-axis aur oopar dashed y-axis. O se lambai r ke do teer: OP₁ x-axis se angle θ par aur OP₂ thora aage, θ + Δθ par. Dono ke beech chhota angle Δθ hai, aur daire par chhota teer P₁ se P₂ tak jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.2(c): Waqt t par OP₁ angle θ par aur Δt baad OP₂ angle θ + Δθ par (kitab ki Figure 3.2(c) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Angle Δθ waqt Δt mein OP ki angular displacement hai. Bohat chhoti Δθ ke liye angular displacement vector quantity hai.
blocks.title: Angular displacement

blocks.text: Agar OP counter clockwise (ghari ki sui ke ulat) ghoome to Δθ ko positive (plus) maana jata hai.
Δθ ki direction rotation ke axis ke saath hoti hai aur right hand rule se maloom hoti hai (Fig. 3.2d):
Rotation ke axis ko daayen haath mein yun pakrein ke ungliyan rotation ki direction mein mudi hon; angootha angular displacement ki direction batata hai.
blocks.title: Right hand rule

blocks.alt: Vertical (seedha khara) rotational (ghoomne wala) axis ek horizontal (zameen ke barabar leta hua) daire ke centre O se guzarta hai; daira elliptical (ande jaisa lamba gol) dikhaya gaya hai. Chhari OP oopar se dekhne par anticlockwise ghoomti hai, P ke paas teer yeh dikhata hai. Daire ke oopar daayan haath axis ko pakarta hai: ungliyan rotation ki direction (rukh) mein mudi aur angutha axis ke saath oopar.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.2(d): Angular displacement ki direction ke liye right-hand rule (kitab ki Figure 3.2(d) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Yahan OP upar se dekhne par anticlockwise ghoom raha hai, is liye ungliyan anticlockwise mudti hain aur angootha upar ki taraf hai: angular displacement (aur angular velocity) upar axis ke saath hai. Rotation clockwise hoti to angootha neeche hota.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Angular displacement teen units mein likhi jati hai: degree, revolution aur radian. Radius r ke daire ka lambai S wala arc lein jo centre par angle θ banata hai (Fig. 3.3). Radian mein:

blocks.alt: Centre O wala daira, horizontal radius OP = r. Doosra radius OP₁, OP se angle θ banata hai. P se P₁ tak ki arc gehri dikhai gayi hai aur us par S likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.3: Radius r ke daire ki lambai S wali arc PP₁ centre O par angle θ banati hai (kitab ki Figure 3.3 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Agar OP ek poora chakkar (revolution) lagaye to point P daire ka poora gher S = 2πr tay karta hai. Radian mein yeh hai:
Angular Velocity

Aksar hum jaanna chahte hain ke koi cheez kitni tez ya aahista ghoom rahi hai. Yeh angular velocity se pata chalta hai: angular displacement ke waqt ke saath badalne ki rate. Fig. 3.2(c) mein agar waqt Δt mein angular displacement Δθ ho to is waqt mein average angular velocity:
Instantaneous (usi lamhe ki) angular velocity ω, Δθ/Δt ki woh value hai jab Δt zero ke qareeb pohanch jaye:

Jab Δt zero ke qareeb ho to angular displacement bohat hi chhoti hoti hai, is liye woh vector hai, aur Eq. 3.3 wali angular velocity bhi vector hai. Is ki direction rotation ke axis ke saath hai aur right hand rule se milti hai.
Angular velocity ka SI unit radian per second (rad s⁻¹) hai. Kabhi kabhi ise revolution per minute (rpm) mein bhi likhte hain.
blocks.title: Angular velocity ka unit

blocks.text: Angular acceleration

Bijli ka pankha (fan) chalayein to us ki angular velocity barhti jati hai; yani us mein angular acceleration hai. Angular acceleration angular velocity ke badalne ki rate hai. Agar waqt tᵢ par angular velocity ωᵢ aur waqt t_f par ω_f ho to waqt t_f − tᵢ mein average angular acceleration:
Instantaneous angular acceleration α, Δω/Δt ki woh value hai jab Δt zero ke qareeb ho:
Angular acceleration bhi vector hai: is ki magnitude (kitna bara) Eq. 3.5 se milti hai aur direction rotation ke axis ke saath hoti hai. Is ka unit rad s⁻² hai.

Ab tak hum ne massless chhari ke sire par laga ek particle P dekha. Ab ek rigid body (sakht cheez jo shakal na badle) ki rotation lein (Fig. 3.4). Object par ek point P sochein; P se rotation ke axis par jo perpendicular line OP girti hai use reference line kehte hain. Jab object ghoomta hai to OP bhi usi angular velocity aur angular acceleration se ghoomti hai. Is liye poore rigid body ki rotation ko us ki reference line OP ki rotation se bayan kiya ja sakta hai, aur OP ke liye jo terms bani thin woh rigid body par bhi lagti hain. Aage hum rigid body ki jagah us ki reference line OP hi lenge.

blocks.alt: Vertical axis, jis ke oopar mura teer rotation dikhata hai. Lamba gulabi rigid body (sakht cheez jo shakal na badle) axis par point O se ek taraf nikla hua hai; us ke andar dashed line r, O se point P tak. Bara elliptical daira woh rasta hai jis par P chalta hai, aur us par teer rotation ki direction batata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.4: Axis ke gird ghoomta rigid body; P se axis par perpendicular OP reference line hai (kitab ki Figure 3.4 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Angular aur linear velocity ka relation (rishta)
Ek rigid body lein jo z-axis ke gird angular velocity ω se ghoom rahi hai (Fig. 3.5a).

blocks.alt: Vertical z-axis, oopar ke qareeb mura teer jis par ω likha hai. Gulabi rigid body axis par O se nikla hai, us ke andar dashed line r, O se point P tak.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.5(a): z-axis ke gird angular velocity ω se ghoomta rigid body (kitab ki Figure 3.5(a) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Object mein axis se perpendicular faasle r par ek point P sochein; OP reference line hai. Object ghoomta hai to P radius r ke daire par linear velocity v se chalta hai aur OP angular velocity ω se ghoomti hai (Fig. 3.5b). Hum ω aur v ka relation nikalna chahte hain. Axis fixed hai, is liye ω ki direction hamesha ek hi rehti hai aur ω ko scalar ki tarah le sakte hain. P ki linear velocity ki bhi sirf magnitude lenge, jo scalar hai.

blocks.alt: Horizontal daira elliptical shakal mein, centre O; y-axis daen, x-axis dekhne wale ki taraf aur z-axis oopar, jis par mota neela teer ω hai. O se radius daire ke agle hisse par P₁ aur P₂ tak jate hain; OP₁ x-axis se angle θ banata hai, OP₁ aur OP₂ ke beech chhota angle Δθ hai, aur arc par P₁ se P₂ tak teer par ΔS likha hai. OP₁ par r likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.5(b): Jab OP Δθ ghoomta hai to point P arc P₁P₂ = ΔS tay karta hai (kitab ki Figure 3.5(b) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: ω ka teer z-axis par upar hai kyunke upar se dekhne par object anticlockwise ghoom raha hai (right hand rule). Chhote waqt Δt mein OP angle Δθ ghoomti hai aur P arc ΔS chalta hai: ΔS = rΔθ. Axis se jitna door point, utni zyada us ki linear speed.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Farz karein waqt Δt mein P faasla P₁P₂ = ΔS tay karta hai aur isi dauran OP angular displacement Δθ radian tay karti hai. Eq. 3.1 se:

blocks.alt: Zameen par radius r ke pahiye ki do haalatein. Pehli mein point A zameen ko chhoo raha hai aur B kinare par oopar ki taraf hai; mura teer dikhata hai ke pahiya daen ludhakte hue clockwise ghoomta hai. Doosri mein pahiya angle θ ghoom chuka hai: ab B zameen ko chhoota hai aur A oopar kinare par hai. Kinare ki arc AB aur zameen ka utna hissa marked hain, aur do chhoone ke points ka faasla S = r θ hai.
blocks.caption: Do You Know (PDF page 57): jab pahiya angle θ ghoomta hai to zameen par tangential faasla S = r θ tay karta hai (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Pahiya phisle baghair ludhakta hai, is liye kinare ka jitna arc AB zameen ko chhoota hai, pahiya utna hi aage barhta hai. Arc ki lambai rθ hai (θ radian mein), is liye pahiya S = rθ aage jata hai. Yahi Eq. 3.1 hai.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Dono taraf Δt se divide karein:
Jab Δt → 0 ho to ΔS/Δt point P ki speed v hai jis se woh daire par chal raha hai, aur Δθ/Δt reference line OP ki angular velocity ω hai. Is liye Eq. 3.6 yeh ban jati hai:

Fig. 3.5(b) mein P arc P₁P₂ par chal raha hai. Jab Δt → 0 ho to arc P₁P₂ bohat chhota ho jata hai aur us ki direction point P₁ par daire ki tangent ki direction hoti hai. Yani P ki velocity ki magnitude v hai aur direction hamesha us point par tangent ke saath hai. Isi liye P ki linear velocity ko tangential velocity bhi kehte hain.
Isi tarah agar OP angular acceleration α se ghoome to P ka linear (tangential) acceleration aₜ hota hai. Eq. 3.7 se yeh relation nikalta hai:

Eq. 3.7 aur 3.8 batati hain ke ghoomte object par axis se different (alag alag) faaslon wale points ki speed aur acceleration alag alag hoti hai, magar fixed axis par ghoomti rigid body ke sab points ki angular displacement, angular speed aur angular acceleration har waqt ek jaisi hoti hai. Is liye angular quantities se poore object ki motion aasani se bayan ho jati hai.
Amusement park mein roller coaster ki top (sab se oonchi jagah) par aap dar to sakte hain, magar ulta (upside down) hone par bhi neeche nahi girte. Kyun?
blocks.title: Point to Ponder (Sochiye)

blocks.text: Top par aap ka wazan (aur seat ka zor) centripetal force ka kaam karta hai jo aap ko daire mein rakhta hai. Agar speed itni ho ke v²/r ≥ g, to zaroori centripetal force wazan se zyada ya barabar hai, aur aap seat se nahi hat-te; is liye neeche nahi girte.
blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein

blocks.text: Angular motion ki equations

Angular motion ki equations (3.2, 3.3, 3.4 aur 3.5) bilkul linear motion ki equations jaisi hain; bas θ, ω aur α ki jagah S, v aur a rakh dein. Linear motion ki baqi equations inhi se algebra ke zariye nikli thin, is liye angular motion ki bhi waisi hi equations hain. Neeche angular equations aur un ki linear counterparts (jori) di gayi hain:
Equations 3.9 se 3.11 sirf tab sahi hain jab rotation ka axis fixed ho, taake sab angular vectors ki direction ek ho aur unhen scalars ki tarah istemal kiya ja sake.

blocks.title: Example 3.1
blocks.problem: Bijli ka pankha 3 rev s⁻¹ se ghoom raha hai. Band karne par woh 18.0 s mein ruk jata hai. Deceleration (speed ka kam hona) uniform (ek jaisi) maan kar us ki value nikalein. Rukne se pehle pankhe ne kitne chakkar (revolutions) lagaye?
steps: Diya gaya: ωᵢ = 3.0 rev s⁻¹, ω_f = 0 (ruk gaya), t = 18.0 s; α = ?, θ = ?
Eq. 3.9 (ω_f = ωᵢ + αt) se: α = (ω_f − ωᵢ)/t = (0 − 3.0) rev s⁻¹ / 18.0 s = −0.167 rev s⁻² (minus ka matlab speed kam ho rahi hai)
blocks.answer: α = −0.167 rev s⁻², aur pankha rukne se pehle 27 chakkar lagata hai.

blocks.prompt: 108 km h⁻¹ se chalti car ke pahiye ka diameter 60 cm hai; pahiye ki angular speed rad s⁻¹ aur rev s⁻¹ mein nikalein. Phir: 1800 rev min⁻¹ par chalti motor band ki jati hai aur 20 s mein uniform taur par ruk jati hai; woh kitne chakkar lagati hai?
blocks.explanation: v = 108 km h⁻¹ = 30 m s⁻¹ aur r = 0.30 m, to ω = v/r = 100 rad s⁻¹ = 100/(2π) ≈ 16 rev s⁻¹. Motor: ωᵢ = 1800 rev min⁻¹ = 30 rev s⁻¹, ω_f = 0, t = 20 s, to α = −30/20 = −1.5 rev s⁻², aur θ = 30 × 20 + ½(−1.5)(20)² = 600 − 300 = 300 rev.

blocks.text: Summary (khulasa)

items: 1 rad: arc = radius. θ = S/r, S = rθ; 1 rev = 2π rad = 360°, 1 rad = 57.3°.
Angular displacement Δθ (chhoti ho to vector), counter clockwise positive, direction right hand rule se axis ke saath.
ω = Δθ/Δt (rad s⁻¹ ya rpm); α = Δω/Δt (rad s⁻²); v = rω, aₜ = rα; linear velocity tangent ke saath.
Fixed axis ke liye: ω_f = ωᵢ + αt; 2αθ = ω_f² − ωᵢ²; θ = ωᵢt + ½αt². Example 3.1: −0.167 rev s⁻², 27 rev.
